recentItems.title: BALIKAN: Trillanes nagdala ng ICC warrant sa Senado para 'sunduin' si Bato | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
BALIKAN (May 11, 2026): Sa kauna-unahang pagkakataon noong Mayo, ipinakita ni dating Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV sa midya ang umano'y kopya ng International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant laban kay Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa.

Nitong Biyernes (Oktubre 23), inanunsyo ni DILG Sec. Jonvic Remulla na naglabas na sila ng P50M pabuya para sa makapagtuturo ng kinaroroonan ni dela Rosa, mag-iisang taon na mula nang ilabas ang nasabing arrest warrant.

recentItems.title: FIFA president Infantino feels 'great' after getting AFC support
recentItems.description:
Asian Football Confederation head Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa endorsed Gianni Infantino's bid for reelection as FIFA president on Friday (October 23), just two months after describing his plan to sell a stake in FIFA tournaments as a "breach of trust".

Infantino faced calls to resign over his failed attempt in July to bring private investors into a new commercial entity holding rights linked to competitions including the World Cup, with Sheikh Salman joining the presidents of UEFA and CONCACAF to pen an open letter criticizing the FIFA president's conduct.

Infantino, who apologized over the handling of the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) project at a FIFA Council meeting in Zurich this month, is up for reelection in March next year and the support of the Asian bloc could prove crucial.

Speaking at the AFC's extraordinary congress in Tokyo on Friday, Sheikh Salman said he had ironed out his differences with Infantino.

recentItems.title: #RosalPH papalabas na, pero nagpapaulan sa Visayas: Paliwanag ng PAGASA
recentItems.description:
Weather update (October 23, 5 p.m.): Typhoon Rosal slightly intensifies east of Taiwan.

At 4 p.m. Friday, it was located 385 km north northeast of Itbayat, Batanes.

It packs winds of 155 kph with gusts up to 190 kph and is moving north northwestward at 20 kph.

Wind signal no. 2 is still in effect over Batanes while signal no. 1 remains hoisted over northern Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, northern Apayao, and northern Ilocos Norte.

Wind signals will be lifted as Rosal continues to move away from Luzon. — Report from Ariel Rojas, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: TV Patrol Express | October 23, 2026
recentItems.description:
Narito ang mga Balita mula sa TV Patrol Express ngayong October 23, 2026.

Headlines:
• Nag-alok ang DILG ng ₱50 milyong pabuya para sa mga impormasyong makatutulong sa pagdakip kay Senador Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa kaugnay ng inilabas na arrest warrant ng International Criminal Court (ICC).
• Nagbabala ang Department of National Defense (DND) na ituturing na "act of war" ang anumang banta o tangkang paghila ng China sa BRP Sierra Madre mula sa Ayungin Shoal sa West Philippine Sea.
• Ulat ng pulisya ukol sa legal na hakbang at imbestigasyon kaugnay ng naganap na insidente sa labas ng Kapitolyo ng Rizal sa Antipolo City.
• Batang nawala mula sa paaralan sa Calamba, Laguna, ligtas nang naibalik sa kanyang pamilya matapos matagpuan sa Tanay, Rizal.
• Alamin ang pinakabagong ulat panahon kaugnay ng pag-alis ng Bagyong Rosal at ang weekend weather forecast mula sa ABS-CBN resident meteorologist na si Ariel Rojas.
• Sa Star Patrol: BINI, lumipad patungong Singapore para sa susunod na leg ng kanilang Signals World Tour; Ilang Kapamilya artists kinilala sa 28th Gawad Pasado Awards.

recentItems.title: DILG offers P50M reward for arrest of Bato dela Rosa | ANC
recentItems.description:
Top Story: The government has offered a P50-million bounty for the arrest of Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, now considered the country’s most wanted person, as authorities intensify their manhunt for the senator facing an International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant.

Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla announced the reward during a press briefing on Friday, October 23, saying authorities had given Dela Rosa enough time and opportunities to surrender. — Report from Karen De Guzman, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Claire Castro keeps post as presidential spokesperson | ANC
recentItems.description:
Top Story: Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro will remain in her post under the leadership of Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Secretary Lino Cayetano, who described the Palace press officer as a “treasure in this government.”

Cayetano confirmed his decision on Friday (October 23) as the PCO reviews the courtesy resignations of its officials following the departure of his predecessor, former Communications Secretary Dave Gomez. — Report from Katrina Domingo, ABS-CBN News
